[[File:Antonin.jpg|250px|thumb|Antonin with a glass of Alderaanian wine]]

'''Alderaanian wine''', also known as a '''Alderaan wine''' or '''Alderaani wine''',<ref name="TCOIH">{{JournalCite|10|The Capture of Imperial Hazard|The Capture of ''Imperial Hazard''}}</ref> was a [[Alcohol/Legends|drink]] served steamed over a [[muskwood]] fire and made on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It had a tart flavor without being overly sour. It was said that the particular vintage was intended for a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] banquet, but when the [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] died trying to capture a krayt dragon, the vintage was used by his widow in his memorial service instead. The wine was a very popular vintage and won many praises.<ref name="X-Wing: The Bacta War" />

A few years before the [[Bacta War]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Talon Karrde]] bid for a case of Alderaanian wine against exotic goods trader [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik]]. The two of them later shared a drink of the same wine before Mirax and her father, [[Booster Terrik]], negotiated supplies and arms from Karrde for [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles's]] war against [[Ysanne Isard]].<ref name="X-Wing: The Bacta War" />

It was enjoyed by [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]], [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] and the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Antonin]].
